item.title: Dortmund-Lütgendortmund
item.description:
With our new location in Dortmund-Lütgendortmund we are expanding our offer of senior-friendly living in a family atmosphere. Situated in a quiet residential neighbourhood, the house provides everything that matters for a safe and fulfilling life in older age.

A home with structure and freedom

Our shared home in Lütgendortmund combines self-determined living with needs-based support. Whether shared breakfast, gardening or an outing in the area — residents actively shape their everyday life here.
